speaker: Doctor
text: The EKG findings and your symptoms are highly concerning for an acute coronary syndrome. Given the elevated cholesterol and ischemic changes, have you experienced any prior heart attacks, stents, or bypass surgery? REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram, BNP.

speaker: Doctor
text: It appears the Echocardiogram and BNP came back normal, which is interesting given the ischemic EKG changes. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Stable Angina Pectoris (due to Coronary Artery Disease).

The normal CT Angiography and BNP, combined with your symptoms occurring only during exertion and your history of hypertension and high cholesterol, confirm this is stable angina rather than an acute heart attack or heart failure. We need to start you on anti-anginal medication immediately and discuss lifestyle changes to manage your risk factors.
